recommendations.status_summary: The model evaluation yields an overall SCRS of 0.7444, placing Generation-(N) in the HIGH_RISK category. Representation Risk is 0.7084 and Uncertainty Risk is 0.7983. Primary collapse risk driver is identified as rep_hidden_state_drift (contribution: 0.1000).
justifications: Synthetic vs Anchor Mix Ratio (Synthetic: 0.25, Anchor: 0.75): Derived continuously to balance innovation with canonical anchor regularization. Elevated drift in representation requires scaling anchor ratio to 0.75 to prevent recursive information entropy accumulation.
Learning Rate (2.02e-06): Adjusted smoothly relative to total risk sensitivity (S=0.8125). Decaying learning rate stabilizes optimization geometry when hidden state drift is detected.
Training Epochs (2): Scaled down to prevent over-fitting to intermediate synthetic output distributions under drift.
Sampling Temperature (0.44): Dampened from baseline 0.70 to sharpen probability distribution and constrain speculative variance during synthetic data generation.
Max Generation Depth (2): Constrained based on remaining collapse safety margin to prevent deep recursive error propagation.
mitigation_actions: Substantially increase anchor ratio to 50%+ to anchor representations.
Apply constrained learning rate and reduced sampling temperature.
Schedule interim Probe evaluation prior to full Generation-(N+2) rollout.
